name: Appwrite
summary: Open-source, self-hostable backend platform: auth, databases, storage, functions, messaging, realtime and hosting.
description: An MCP and agent-first backend-as-a-service with Auth, Databases, Storage, Functions, Sites, Messaging, Realtime and a Firewall. Connect coding agents to a live project through the hosted MCP server or integrate one of the SDKs for web, mobile, native and server platforms; self-host with one Docker command or use Appwrite Cloud.
contains: Auth, Databases, Storage, Functions, Sites, Messaging, Firewall, Realtime
hosted MCP server (OAuth) so agents operate a live project
self-host via one Docker command; one-click on DigitalOcean, AWS, Akamai, Gitpod
SDKs for Web, Flutter, Apple, Android, React Native, Node, Python, Dart, PHP, Ruby, .NET, Go, Swift, Kotlin, Rust
Appwrite Cloud includes a free plan, with paid plans to scale
